_: App Store screenshots (5 Oct 2026). One entry per slide, in store order: the first three show in search. Every line must be true of the app today (CLAUDE.md): no score, points, certified, CCC, therapy, treatment, diagnosis, evaluation or accuracy; no price and no 'free'; no game counts or 'every week'; no quotes or reviews; only games a child can open. Rachel's line is Travis's, word for word, and her name always carries 'MS, CF-SLP'. title: two lines, the 'accent' one (0 or 1) in the warm orange. scene: the raw screen capture.mjs writes. bg: two colours, top to bottom, soft. status: the status bar's ink over that screen. decor: at most two small pictures from public/, placed in canvas fractions (x, y of the centre; w of the width); 'behind' puts one under the phone.
